agent.title: AI / MCP
agent.description: Connect your local AI agent to query accounts, holdings, history and period analysis, and manage household records when permitted.
agent.running: MCP is running on this computer
agent.ledgerWrite: Read, maintain directories and record activity
agent.writeHelp: Read data and create, edit or archive members, institutions, groups, accounts and instruments without another App confirmation. This permission does not allow ledger entries or balance changes.
agent.ledgerHelp: Also allows recording income, expenses, trades, transfers, FX, dividends and debt activity; importing existing positions; posting atomic batches; transferring positions; reconciling current balances, quantities and total costs; and undoing or correcting activity. For ledger records, the agent previews before committing, without per-action confirmation in the App. This permission also allows importing, correcting and withdrawing Agent-supplied prices, unit NAVs and exchange rates, and fetching prices and exchange rates from configured providers and rebuilding historical snapshots to repair data health issues. This does not place brokerage orders.
agent.readHelp: Allows directory, current valuation, activity history and closed-day period analysis queries. The agent cannot change data.
agent.secretHelp: Contains an access token. Copy this configuration to your local agent and keep it private.
agent.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the configuration and copy it manually.

cloudBackup.title: Continuous backup
cloudBackup.description: Back up this machine to Cloudflare R2 while Nestworth is running. Off by default; closing the app stops backup.
cloudBackup.sensitive: Backups contain the household database, including existing provider keys and AI / MCP settings. R2 credentials stay in the separate local backup configuration database, stored as plaintext with private file permissions.
cloudBackup.pairHelp: Replace both credentials together. Blank inputs keep stored keys. Remove disables backup and never deletes remote history.
cloudBackup.successHelp: This time records a completed, remote-confirmed backup attempt. Later writes may still be awaiting capture.
cloudBackup.connectionPassed: The bucket can be listed. This connection check does not confirm a backup or write permission.
cloudBackup.error: The operation did not complete. Check the saved settings, credential pair and network connection, then retry. Local records remain available.
cloudBackup.recoveryHelp: Choose a stream and recovery point, inspect the candidate, then confirm explicitly. Recovery replaces local records and keeps a safety copy. Only schema 15 is supported. Listing shows up to 100 recent points per stream; remote history is retained.
cloudBackup.empty: No recovery points found. Nothing was restored.
cloudBackup.restorePaused: Continuous backup will be paused. After restarting and reviewing the restored records, enable it to begin a new isolated stream.
cloudBackup.restoreDescription: The downloaded candidate will replace local records. Nestworth will quit after installation; reopen it to verify the restored data. Unsaved forms will be lost.

restoreStates.installing: Installing recovery and preparing to quit

cloudBackup.moreHelp: More storage history remains to be checked. Continue even if this page contains no recovery points.
cloudBackup.loadedOnly: Only loaded recovery points are shown. Refresh to discover newly added backups.

retention.title: History retention
retention.description: Keep backups forever by default. Optional cleanup removes whole sealed streams older than the selected period. The current stream and two restore-verified sealed streams stay protected. Cleanup runs only while the app is open; a long-running current stream has no hard storage limit.
retention.error: Cleanup could not finish safely. Refresh the preview and check the connection and delete permission. Backup status is separate.
retention.insufficient: Cleanup is skipped until two sealed streams can be restored and verified.
retention.empty: No streams found in this backup target.
retention.warning: Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. Cleanup deletes eligible whole backup streams after rechecking the target and protected copies. Partial cleanup may finish on a later attempt. Only enable this if you accept losing older recovery history.
retention.acknowledge: I understand older backup history will be permanently deleted.

reasons.restore-preview: Protected: recovery preview in this session
reasons.insufficient-survivors: Protected: fewer than two verified survivors

investmentReview.scope: Opt in per investment. Uses dated unit NAV for actively held funds and bank investment holdings; thresholds are your review preferences.

holdingPerformance.label: Price performance
holdingPerformance.infoBody: Change in the daily closing price or unit NAV between the dates shown. Intraday quotes are excluded, dividends are not included and corporate actions are not adjusted, so this is not your holding return. Annualized figures are historical, not an expected or guaranteed yield.

reason.insufficient_daily_history: Not enough history for this period

reasonDetail.insufficient_daily_history: Dated daily closing prices that reach back to the start of this period are needed.
reasonDetail.incomparable_daily_prices: Daily prices cannot be compared across this period. Check their currency, price basis and any distributions or unit changes.
reasonDetail.unsupported_instrument: Historical price performance is unavailable for this instrument type.

holdingPerformance.emptyHint: Record or sync daily closing prices. Timestamped manual prices are available in Market Data.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.localOnly: Check your records against Nestworth. Corrections update this local ledger, not your bank or broker. Market prices and FX can lag without invalidating cash or quantity checks.
reconciliation.error: Unable to load or save reconciliation.
reconciliation.stale: Refresh failed. Showing previously loaded evidence.
reconciliation.recheck: Bookkeeping changed after this record. Its completed evidence and time are preserved.
reconciliation.recordMissing: Record missing income, expense, buy or sell
reconciliation.correctionHelp: A direct correction records an audited adjustment. Increasing quantity requires either the added units’ unit cost or the entire remaining position’s total cost. Use the transaction route for a real missing buy or sell.
reconciliation.explicitReview: Confirm only what you have reviewed. Saving a correction does not confirm a check.
reconciliation.productRoute: Correct product terms or record actual receipt
reconciliation.importPosition: Record an existing position without a trade

validation.source: Statement or source reference and source date: provide both to confirm this check.
validation.asOfDate: Source date: choose a valid date.
validation.asOfTime: Source time: choose a valid time in the ledger timezone.
validation.allowPartial: Select “Finish partially with outstanding checks” and add a closing explanation.
validation.note: Explanation or note: explain why this check is skipped or unresolved.
validation.outcome: Outcome: choose confirmed, skipped, unresolved or pending.
validation.referenceValue: Source and ledger values differ. Correct the ledger, leave unresolved, or explain the difference before confirming.
validation.referenceComparable: Only compare a numeric source figure with the current checkpoint when their units, currency and as-of basis match. Older statements and descriptive text can be kept as evidence without comparison.

reconciliation.overlap: An unfinished session already includes these accounts. Continue it above, or start a separate record. The sessions keep independent evidence.
reconciliation.laterBookkeeping: Bookkeeping has changed since this successful check.
reconciliation.scopeHelp: Check currencies, positions, products and unsettled records. Record omissions here; no check confirmation is needed first.
reconciliation.archivedNonzero: Archived instrument or holding still has units. Review this position before finishing.
reconciliation.readOnly: Completed records are read-only. Start a new session for another check.
reconciliation.finishNotice: Finish saves an immutable record of these checks. A paused session can also be finished. Corrections remain separate ledger entries.
reconciliation.changedReview: The ledger or session has changed. Current evidence is being refreshed. Close this review and check the new figures before previewing again.
reconciliation.comparable: Compare: same units, currency and current as-of basis
reconciliation.comparisonHelp: Only compare a numeric source figure with the current checkpoint when their units, currency and as-of basis match. Older statements and descriptive text can be kept as evidence without comparison.
reconciliation.mismatch: Source and ledger values differ. Correct the ledger, leave unresolved, or explain the difference before confirming.
reconciliation.costChoice: For a quantity increase, enter exactly one: added units’ cost per unit OR the entire remaining holding’s total cost.
reconciliation.firstBaseline: First successful baseline has not been established for this account.
reconciliation.noChanges: No bookkeeping changes in this interval.
reconciliation.maturityHelp: Maturity changes the contract date; it does not record money received. Record receipt only when cash actually arrives.
reconciliation.costUnitInvalid: Enter a non-negative cost per unit with up to eight decimal places.
reconciliation.costUnitIncreaseOnly: Added-unit cost applies only when increasing quantity. Use total remaining cost for this correction.
reconciliation.costOnlyTotal: To change cost without changing quantity, enter the total remaining cost.
reconciliation.costZeroQuantity: A holding with zero quantity must have zero total cost.
reconciliation.costCurrency: Total cost must use the instrument’s currency.
reconciliation.costPrecision: This total cost cannot be represented at the supported per-unit precision. Adjust the total cost.
reconciliation.costTotalInvalid: Enter a non-negative total cost with up to four decimal places.
reconciliation.historicalCoverageGap: Current inventory contains archived positions with nonzero units that are not covered by this historical record. This does not establish whether they existed when it was completed.
reconciliation.inventoryCoverageGap: The saved checklist omitted a currently archived position with nonzero units. It has been added as a pending check.
reconciliation.workingBookkeepingChanged: Bookkeeping changed since these working checkpoints. Review the refreshed pending checks.
reconciliation.pendingReview: Some checkpoints still need review before finishing.
reconciliation.coverageNewCheck: Start a new reconciliation to review the current coverage. The historical evidence and completion time are unchanged.
reconciliation.restoreBeforeCorrection: Restore the archived holding or instrument before adjusting it or recording a missing transaction. Evidence review, disposition and partial finish remain available.
